note: Every note of pya-gakki/scores/daylife_ttfaf_maj.json (Day Life, TTFAF-style arrangement in E♭ major), made by tools/site/build_daylife.py. A note is [bar (from 1), beat in the bar (from 0, quarter notes), length in beats, MIDI pitch or drum hit name, velocity]. The accomp figures are expanded as pya-gakki/tools/render_score.py expands them.
